import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            v = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return
        if not np.isfinite(v):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(v, 1) if metric in ("share", "rank") or period in ("WoW", "YoY") else round(v, 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    num_cols = ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
                "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]
    for c in num_cols:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    # ---- Totals ----
    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (tw - lw) / lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (tw - ly) / ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")

    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - u_lw) / u_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", (df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True) - o_lw) / o_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    # ---- Largest entities ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(5).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for this product")
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        if pd.notna(r.get("Share_Pct")):
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", r["Share_Pct"], "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        else:
            add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else None,
                "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top) >= 5:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100 if tw else None,
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top):
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", 1.0, "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # ---- WoW movers (absolute revenue change) ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    if len(d):
        up = d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(2)
        dn = d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(2)
        for _, r in up.iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
        for _, r in dn.iterrows():
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- WoW percent movers on a meaningful base ----
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_TW"]).copy()
    base = p["Revenue_LW"].fillna(0) >= max(p["Revenue_LW"].fillna(0).median(), 1)
    p = p[base] if base.sum() >= 2 else p
    if len(p):
        b = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        w = p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").iloc[0]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", b["WoW_Pct"], "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
        add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", w["WoW_Pct"], "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct", "Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    yb = y[y["Revenue_LY"] >= max(y["Revenue_LY"].median(), 1)]
    y2 = yb if len(yb) >= 2 else y
    if len(y2):
        b = y2.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        w = y2.sort_values("YoY_Pct").iloc[0]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", b["YoY_Pct"], "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
        add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", w["YoY_Pct"], "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    ya = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    if len(ya):
        ya["abs_yoy"] = ya["Revenue_TW"] - ya["Revenue_LY"]
        b = ya.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        w = ya.sort_values("abs_yoy").iloc[0]
        add(b["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", b["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
        add(w["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", w["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")

    # ---- Units / orders leaders ----
    uu = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"])
    if len(uu):
        r = uu.sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", r["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW) across products")
    oo = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"])
    if len(oo):
        r = oo.sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).iloc[0]
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", r["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW) across products")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
